mutation_targets.name: write_data_length_mismatch
mutation_targets.reason: Write Var has coupled parameter and data lengths; mismatches may expose parser bugs.

mutation_targets.name: control_and_block_functions
mutation_targets.reason: PLC control and block-management functions tend to be stateful and privileged.

constraints: Prefer valid stateful message sequences that pass COTP and S7 setup.
Prioritize deep protocol functions, boundary lengths, item counts, invalid areas, DB edge cases, write/control/download-like functions.
Avoid recommendations that only create random garbage or huge packets.
prompt.goal: Rank seeds and suggest mutation targets likely to expose S7COMM PLC protocol vulnerabilities, not just improve AFL metrics.
